description: This file defines the SBCSGroupProber class, which is part of a charset detection library. It aggregates multiple charset probers, particularly for single-byte encodings including Russian, Greek, Hebrew, and Thai, and manages Hebrew probing logic. The class initializes various charset probers and organizes them for charset detection tasks.

classes.name: SBCSGroupProber
classes.description: A charset prober that combines multiple single-byte charset probers, especially for relevant language models, including Hebrew, Russian, Greek, Bulgarian, Thai, and Turkish, for charset detection.
